reproduction.expected: The real pretool shadow call passes application-owned available input evidence, evaluation time and issuer validators into Typed Coverage.
reproduction.actual: The real pretool shadow call invoked build_pretool_shadow_plan with only state and capability_registry, so typed validators always saw empty evidence, no trusted time and no issuer validators.

violated_invariants: Typed evidence must be supplied only by an application-owned trust root.
A typed shadow result must be comparable to a real pretool invocation.
Missing trust roots must fail closed without widening capability selection.
